description: Weighted Average Call/Notice Money Rates, monthly (per cent per annum); High, Low and Average rows per fiscal year (April-March)
publisher: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (DBIE)
report: Statistics > Financial Market > Money Market > Weighted Average Call/Notice Money Rates (Monthly, 30-Apr-1991 to 30-Sep-2026), SAP Web Intelligence report 'Weighted Average Call Money Rates'
method: Table cells read from the rendered DBIE report in a browser and written to CSV with empty cells preserved; SHA-256 of the CSV computed in the browser and verified after saving
cross_check: rbi_handbook_2025-26_table174.pdf (Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy 2025-26, Table 174) covers 2020-21 to 2026-27; values must match (tested)
notes: Includes notice money. The model uses the 'Average' row; fiscal year YYYY-YY maps Apr-Dec to YYYY and Jan-Mar to YYYY+1.
